In conversation with Hormazd Sorabjee, Sabari Manohar, EVP, Toyota Kirloskar Motor, discusses the thinking behind Toyota's first flex-fuel hybrid, its ability to run on E20 to E85, and how the company plans to address customer concerns around ethanol blends.
Editor: Deven Bhalla
